background: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production HD wraparound background texture for Yoshimitsu's forest fighting stage in Tekken 3. Edit target is the supplied reconstructed panoramic forest image. Remaster it into richly detailed, naturalistic high definition game environment artwork. Preserve the full panorama composition and all main tree trunks, canopy, mossy temple perimeter wall with dark tiled coping, the small gate, and bamboo fence, their relative horizontal positions and heights. Ancient tall Japanese cedar forest, intricately textured bark, crisp natural leaves and moss, atmospheric muted warm gray-green mist between distant vertical trunks, deep olive greens, soft overcast daylight. The lower boundary is the foot of the wall and tree roots at fighting-ground level. Keep the entire view from left edge to right edge; this is an ultra-wide cylindrical panorama, not a camera screenshot. Left and right edges should join naturally when wrapped. Remove original low-resolution pixelation, dithering and jagged edges; replace them with real fine organic material detail. Preserve the original scene's moody restrained colors, avoiding fluorescent greens or sunny fantasy lighting. No people, fighters, UI, text, watermark, new buildings, paths, or foreground objects. Generate an ultra-wide high-resolution image, ideally 4096 by 1024, matching the reference's 4:1 aspect ratio. This is the background art only.
ground: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production seamless albedo texture for the fighting ground of Yoshimitsu's forest stage in Tekken 3. The provided tiny green ground texture is the edit reference for material and olive-green palette only. Create a completely detailed HD replacement: a continuous dense carpet of soft short woodland moss with fine fern-like tiny moss fronds, subtle dark compact earth showing irregularly through it, a very few tiny dull leaf fragments and embedded grit. Directly overhead orthographic material scan, absolutely flat view, uniform soft diffuse overcast illumination. Natural rich but subdued moss greens, olive and dark umber shadows, consistent with a misty ancient Japanese cedar forest. Organic varied detail distributed evenly across the whole square with no focal point, no obvious repeating patches, no stones larger than tiny gravel, no tree roots, no grass blades sticking up, no path or objects. The opposite borders must tile perfectly both horizontally and vertically. Crisp fine realistic game material detail suitable for close-up HD floor rendering. Entire square filled edge to edge with the material: no borders, no margins, no black bars. No perspective, no horizon, no UI, no text, no watermarks. Generate at high resolution 2048 by 2048 if possible.
